Actions.Text: AMEND (T) AND RECOMMIT TO ENVIRONMENTAL CONSERVATION

Title: Requires the public service commission to conduct audits of private water companies
Summary: Establishes the "small water utility transparency act"; requires the public service commission to conduct audits of certain private water companies; requires certain private water companies which are under certain investigations to file public updates on the status of compliance with such orders.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the public service law, in relation to reporting requirements and audits of private water companies
